title: The Demonic Path Commander Appears
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path Commander's lips curved into a meaningful smile, revealing news that sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine—Ye Qing's betrayal, from the very beginning, was part of the Fate's Twin Born plan.

text.content:
The wind and clouds shifted abruptly, the sky darkened suddenly.

The sky above the ruins entrance seemed soaked in ink, rolling black clouds churned like boiling water, and a massive blood-red transmission formation slowly took shape within the depths of the clouds. The formation runes writhed like living creatures, emitting an overwhelming ancient demonic might.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

He had just been contemplating the world-shaking prophecy left by that ancient great cultivator—the Fate's Twin Born, the only possibility to break the deadly situation, with the cost being the complete annihilation of one of them. Before his words even faded, heaven and earth had already changed, as if something in the darkness was anxiously eager to unveil this karmic situation.

"It's here." Chen Ji murmured, his fingertips tightening slightly. He should have known that since that mysterious great cultivator was willing to reveal such Heavenly Secrets, there must be a deeper layout.

The blood-red formation runes shuddered violently, and a figure stepped out slowly from within, surrounded by overwhelming demonic flames, black hair wild dancing like snakes.

That face—

Chen Ji froze on the spot.

It was a face identical to his own, yet carrying a completely different sharpness and arrogance. The brow and eye contours, the curve of the lips, even the scar on his left cheek from falling off a cliff in childhood—all were precisely the same. The only difference was those eyes—within the jet-black pupils, blood-red threads intertwined like a net, burning with a berserk intensity.

"Chen Ji..." the figure spoke, voice low as an abyss echoing, "We, finally meet."

The surrounding cultivators all changed color; someone exclaimed: "Demonic Path Commander! The Demonic Path Commander has come personally!"

The unrest spread like a plague. The name of the Demonic Path Commander was enough to make half of the cultivation world tremble—it was said his cultivation was peerless, his methods ruthless, having destroyed seven minor sects in three months, leaving corpses strewn everywhere he went.

Yet at this moment, this decisive and merciless demonic overlord merely gazed quietly at Chen Ji.

"Your expression is quite interesting." The Demonic Path Commander's mouth curved slightly, "Surprise? Fear? Or... a hunter who has finally waited for the prey to take the bait, calculating what position to use to slaughter me?"

Chen Ji slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.

He remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said—that the holder of the Tianji Record was not the only bearer. Ten thousand years ago, during that sacrifice, the Eye of Heaven needed a vessel, so it forcibly tore a complete fate apart, leaving half in the mortal realm to bear karma, while the other half was sealed within the depths of Heavenly Dao's laws.

He had always thought that was merely metaphorical.

"So..." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "You are the other half? The half that was peeled away from me by the Eye of Heaven?"

"Peeled away?" The Demonic Path Commander burst into laughter, the sound mournful like ghostly wailing, "What a lovely way to put it. Chen Ji, do you think I'm the unlucky bastard dragged down by you? Wrong—you are the chosen vessel to endure suffering, and I am the true castaway."

dialogue.content:
"Castaway?" Chen Ji's brow slightly lifted, his tone indifferent.

The Demonic Path Commander stepped forward, the demonic flames around him transforming into visions of ten thousand ghosts wailing: "Ten thousand years ago, the Eye of Heaven needed a vessel to bear the power of prophecy. It chose a human—that human possessed unprecedented talent, sufficient to touch the mysteries of Heavenly Secrets."

"But it wasn't satisfied with merely borrowing." The Demonic Path Commander's voice turned abruptly cold, "It wanted to completely refine that person into its own chess piece. However, a single person's soul was too complete to be fully controlled. So it came up with a method—"

"Split."

Chen Ji interjected, his voice heavy and凝.

"Correct." The Demonic Path Commander nodded, "It split that person's fate in two. One half retained emotions and reason, becoming what the world calls a 'prophet'; the other half had all bindings stripped away, leaving only the craving for power, becoming an eternal battle machine."

He pointed at Chen Ji: "You, are the former. And I—"

Black hair wild dancing, burning with overwhelming hatred in those blood-red pupils: "I am the evil deliberately forged by it, the blade destined to perish together with you!"

text.content:
Thunder roared and wind howled, the energy between heaven and earth becoming chaotic to the extreme.

Chen Ji listened quietly, yet his expression held no fluctuation whatsoever. He raised his eyes to gaze at that face identical to his own and slowly spoke: "So what? You appearing today, surely you don't intend to just tell me a tragic story."

The Demonic Path Commander narrowed his eyes, seemingly quite surprised by Chen Ji's composure.

"Interesting." He chuckled low, "As expected, the vessel chosen to bear emotions, its depth is also extraordinary. Very well, I'll be direct then—" he stepped forward, merely three zhang away from Chen Ji, "The fate between us allows only one to survive. This, you should know better than anyone."

Chen Ji did not deny.

The price of the Tianji Record, he understood better than anyone. Each point of Heavenly Fate consumed brought him one step closer to death. And for the Fate's Twin Born to truly break the Eye of Heaven's chess game, there was only one possibility—devour each other, fuse and become one.

"But I don't want to do it this way." The Demonic Path Commander suddenly shifted direction, a complex light flickering in his eyes, "Ten thousand years is too long, Chen Ji. I'm fed up with being manipulated by that damned eye, fed up with being someone else's chess piece."

He extended his hand: "Cooperate with me. Together we break these shackles. As for what comes after... we'll discuss who should perish then."

The air at the entrance of the Ancient Forbidden Land was thick with suffocating tension.

Cultivators from the two major powers dared not act rashly—the fate entanglement flowing between these two individuals was sufficient to shake the very laws of heaven and earth. Interfering would be certain death.

Yet at that moment, a cold voice rang out: "No."

Everyone turned to see a slender figure stepping out from Chen Ji's side, placing herself between him and the Demonic Path Commander.

It was Chen Ling.

Her face was pale to the point of translucence, a trace of blood still visible at the corner of her mouth—clearly, blocking that lethal strike for Chen Ji had pushed her to her absolute limit. But her gaze was unwavering, fixed directly on that face identical to her brother's.

"Who are you?" The Demonic Path Commander's brow furrowed.

"Chen Ling." She spoke each word with deliberate precision. "Chen Ji's younger sister. The final host of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

Her gaze swept across the Demonic Path Commander before returning to Chen Ji: "Brother, you cannot cooperate with him. If the Twin Fates merge as one, it may indeed break the Heavenly Dao shackles—but the price is the complete annihilation of one of them. This outcome, I will never permit."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not speak, merely watching Chen Ling quietly.

He noticed that when his sister said "final host," a subtle fluctuation flickered in the Demonic Path Commander's eyes. It wasn't surprise, but rather... confirmation.

"You know something." Chen Ji's voice was deep.

Chen Ling lowered her eyes, as if deliberating. After a moment, she softly said: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key... it's not just about sealing fate. When the Heavenly Eye split you two apart, to prevent the two halves from reconnecting, it buried a safeguard within the entire scheme—"

"Chen Ling!" The Demonic Path Commander suddenly interjected, his blood-colored eyes blazing, "You've said too much."

A wave of overwhelming demonic pressure surged toward Chen Ling like a tide.

Chen Ji's figure vanished from its original position.

The next instant, he stood before Chen Ling, a rune in his palm exploding outward, forcibly shredding that demonic pressure. The aftershock sent him staggering back three steps, blood seeping from his wrist.

"Brother!" Chen Ling cried out.

Chen Ji raised a hand to stop her, his gaze sharp as a blade, piercing directly at the Demonic Path Commander: "You want to silence her? It seems what she has to say is far more important than your performance."

text.content:
The Demonic Path Commander's expression darkened.

"Chen Ji, you and I were originally one." His voice no longer carried the prior composure, gaining a chilling edge. "Merging as one is a fate neither of us can escape. Rather than being toyed with by that Heavenly Eye until death, why not choose proactively—"

"Proactively choose who gets to die?" Chen Ji coldly laughed.

His smile made the Demonic Path Commander's pupils contract sharply—it wasn't the madness of the desperate, nor the howling of the furious, but rather an bone-deep chill, as if looking at a clown performing.

"You speak so eloquently." Chen Ji slowly began, his voice not loud, yet clearly reaching every person present. "What was it again? Being manipulated by heaven, not wanting to be a chess piece, ten thousand years being too long..."

He stepped forward, facing the Demonic Path Commander directly: "But you forgot one thing—I am the one who holds the Tianji Record. For ten thousand years, every trace and clue about you, I've already investigated thoroughly."

"Your appearance today isn't because you want to cooperate. It's because the Heavenly Eye's time limit for you is running out, and you're forced to close your net early."

At these words, the Demonic Path Commander's expression completely darkened.

"You thought my ten thousand years were spent merely sleeping?" Chen Ji continued, his tone terrifyingly calm. "Although incomplete, the fragments of the Tianji Record record numerous details about that ancient sacrifice. The Heavenly Eye split fate to prevent the seer from glimpsing its true form."

"But it overlooked one thing—" Chen Ji drew a yellowed fragment from his sleeve, the runes upon it faintly glowing. "It believed that by severing you, it could cut my connection to the Source of Fate. But it forgot that the severed half is equally part of fate."

He tossed the fragment into the air.

The runes suddenly blazed to life, and a illusory screen materialized—the ancient scene recorded by the Tianji Record.

In the image, a complete soul was forcibly torn apart by the Heavenly Eye, two lights—one black, one white—plunging in opposite directions. Yet in that instant of tearing, a thread thinner than a strand of silk始终牵连着两端。

"This is your greatest flaw." Chen Ji pointed to that thread of light. "No matter how you struggle, the fate bond between us can never be completely severed."

The Demonic Path Commander's pupils contracted violently.

He stared at that illusory thread of light, his expression shifting rapidly—rage, shock, but more than anything, a不甘被看穿的不甘。

"Good... good indeed, the Tianji Record holder." He laughed lowly, the sound growing increasingly unrestrained. "Chen Ji, I underestimated you."

However, in the next instant, his smile abruptly froze.

Because Chen Ji's next words completely shattered his calculations.

"You speak of cooperating with me, of deciding who should perish after merging as one." Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice. "But what you failed to mention is—after merging, whose consciousness would be preserved, correct?"

The Demonic Path Commander's silence was the best answer.

"You severed all emotions, leaving only a craving for power." Chen Ji spoke each word with precision. "If I let you succeed, what would survive the merge would never be Chen Ji—rather, your ambition, your greed, your hatred toward the Heavenly Eye."

He stepped back, creating distance from the Demonic Path Commander: "Such 'cooperation,' I regret to decline."

Swords drawn, bows drawn.

The air seemed frozen, two terrifying auras colliding, intertwining, and clashing in the Void. The surrounding cultivators hastily retreated, afraid of being caught in the crossfire.

The Demonic Path commander’s face sank to the depths. He said nothing more, only slowly raising his right hand—a jet-black demonic pattern began burning in his palm.

That was the mark of Heavenly Dao Laws.

"Since you refuse to cooperate..." His voice rumbled like thunder, "then we can only decide our fates in the most ancient way."

Demonic flames surged to the heavens, sweeping across all corners of the world.

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet in his hand he secretly gripped a jade talisman—a lifeline left behind by Mo Xiansheng, never to be used unless absolutely necessary.

But just as both sides were about to strike, Chen Ling suddenly spoke again: "Wait!"

Her voice trembled slightly, yet rang with unusual firmness: "The fusion of fate's twin children doesn't have to be a path where only one survives. Brother, did you forget what that ancient powerhouse said in the end?"

Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly.

"He said—'The price is that one of them must be completely annihilated.'" Chen Ling took a deep breath. "But he also said this was the 'only possibility to break the deadlock.' Perhaps these two sentences... can be interpreted differently."

Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation.

Those words from the ancient powerhouse did carry profound meaning. At the time, his entire mind had been captured by the word "annihilation," ignoring another key phrase—"break the deadlock."

If fusion was the only way out, why did the powerhouse speak with such certainty, as if he had already foreseen them walking this path?

Unless...

"You've thought of something?" The Demonic Path commander suddenly spoke, his expression subtly shifting. "Correct, I have been pondering this question as well. The Heavenly Eye split us apart to prevent the seer from glimpsing its true form. But it calculated everything, yet failed to account for one thing—"

He paused, a complex light flickering in those jet-black eyes: "It didn't split two vessels, but two perspectives. The future you see, and the past I see, will eventually converge at a certain point."

"届时——" "At that time—" The two spoke in unison.

"A fate loop." Chen Ji said deeply.

"And the key to breaking the loop..." The Demonic Path commander slowly withdrew the demonic pattern from his palm, "may never have been within us."

Just as the atmosphere grew微妙, a cold scoff suddenly rang out from the distance.

"Touching reunion drama."

Everyone turned to look. An elderly figure strode through the air from the depths of the ruins. Hair white as snow, face calm as an ancient well, yet his aura was as unfathomable as an abyss.

It was Ling Yuan.

The former sect master of Tianqing Sect appearing at this moment was absolutely no coincidence.

"The old senior arrives at just the right time." Chen Ji said calmly, his tone revealing no emotion whatsoever.

Ling Yuan glanced at him, then at the Demonic Path commander, finally resting his gaze on Chen Ling. A meaningfully profound smile appeared on his aged face: "Fate's twin children... interesting. This old one has lived for several thousand years, yet this is the first time witnessing such a spectacle."

He slowly walked toward Chen Ji, each step seeming to tread upon the nodes of destiny: "Chen Ji, do you know who originally passed down the Tianji Record to you?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly.

Ling Yuan's smile grew deeper: "It was my senior brother—and the moment he passed the Tianji Record to you before his death... doomed today's farce."

Ling Yuan's words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer.

He should have realized it long ago. Mo Xiansheng's identity had always been a mystery—why would a residual soul guardian possess a Tianji Record Fragment? Why would he appear when Chen Ji was at his lowest, willing to serve as his guide?

"How much do you actually know?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice.

Ling Yuan did not answer directly. Instead, he looked toward the Demonic Path commander: "How much do you know?"

The Demonic Path commander's expression became extremely ugly. He stared fixedly at Ling Yuan, murderous intent churning in his eyes, yet he hesitated to strike—as if fearing something.

"It seems you both know something, yet neither knows everything." Ling Yuan chuckled lightly. "Fine, since everyone's gathered today, let this old one enlighten you—"

He raised his hand, a profound light emerging from his palm,勾勒出一幅古老的阵图在空中. At the center of the formation diagram, two points of light were connected by a crimson thread—precisely the fate lines of the twin children.

"That ancient sacrifice, my senior brother was supposed to be the main character." Ling Yuan's voice drifted hauntingly. "But with great wisdom and will, he deceived the Heavenly Eye,剥离 his own fate and transferring it onto two innocent infants—"

"Those two infants were you."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji lifted his head sharply.

Two infants—not split, but transferred?

He had always believed himself to be a continuation of that sacrifice, a vessel chosen by the Heavenly Eye. But now Ling Yuan was telling him he was merely an innocent scapegoat?

"What nonsense are you spouting!" The Demonic Path commander interrupted sharply, crimson light blazing in his jet-black eyes. "I clearly sensed it—the mark of Heavenly Dao Laws, right in the depths of my soul!"

"That was your own choice." Ling Yuan said calmly.

"What?"

"When my senior brother transferred your fates, he deliberately left a gap." Ling Yuan looked toward the Demonic Path commander. "He hoped that at least one of you would awaken self-awareness during your growth, breaking free from the shackles of fate."

"However—" His tone turned abruptly cold. "You did not choose to break free. You chose to devour. Piece by piece, you剥离 and devoured the fragments of Chen Ji's fate, gradually making yourself complete."

"This is also why you can sense the mark of Heavenly Dao Laws. Because those marks were originally things belonging to Chen Ji!"

text.content:
"The Demonic Path commander's figure trembled violently.

"Impossible..." His voice was hoarse. "I clearly..."

"Clearly the victim?" Ling Yuan coldly smiled. "Ten thousand years is enough to distort any memory. You only remember the pain of being split apart and abandoned, but you forgot—who struck first."

Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression betraying nothing, yet his heart was churning like a tempest.

He remembered what Mo Xiansheng once said: "Some truths, knowing them is a burden."

At the time he thought it was comfort. Now he understood—Mo Xiansheng may have known everything from the start, choosing only to tell him what he needed to know.

"So..." Chen Ji spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "My master giving me the Tianji Record was not coincidence. He had already calculated today's events?"

Ling Yuan nodded. "Your master's布局 never fails. He gave you the Tianji Record because he believed you could make the right choice—"

"What choice?" The Demonic Path commander abruptly raised his head, his eyes filled with blood-red madness. "Choice to let him devour me?!"

"Neither."

An aged voice suddenly rang out, carrying a sigh.

Everyone turned to see a illusory figure slowly emerge from the Jade Pendant in Chen Ji's arms—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul.

"Sir!" Chen Ji exclaimed.

Mo Xiansheng gave him a slight nod, then turned to the Demonic Path commander, his eyes flashing with complex emotions. "My ten-thousand-year布局 was not for you to devour each other, nor for one to replace the other."

"Then what was it for?" The Demonic Path commander demanded.

Mo Xiansheng didn't answer directly. Instead, he turned to Chen Ji. "Chen Ji, how many futures have you seen with the Tianji Record?"

Chen Ji was stunned. "Three hundred and seventy-two times. Each time consuming five Heavenly Fate points, totaling one thousand eight hundred and sixty points."

"Then have you ever seen—your own future?"

Chen Ji shook his head. The Tianji Record cannot foresee fate directly connected to its user—this had always been his regret.

Mo Xiansheng smiled, laughter carrying a sense of liberation. "That is because your future, from the very beginning, does not exist."

"Does not exist?" Chen Ji frowned.

"Fate's twin children are a death trap set by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets." Mo Xiansheng slowly explained. "Whether you choose cooperation or confrontation, there is only one ending—devoured by it, becoming nourishment for breaking its seal."

"My ten-thousand-year布局 is to break this death trap." His voice gradually strengthened. "The method is simple—if Fate's twin children are two sides of one coin, then let the 'one body' reappear."

"But not fusion." He turned. "It is 'Shared Fate.'"

Chen Ji's heart trembled.

Shared Fate—the buff unlocked when Su Qingyao's affection maxes out, allowing her to share Heavenly Fate consumption for Chen Ji. If a similar connection could be established between Fate's twin children...

"Correct." Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his thoughts. "If you can establish a 'Shared Fate' contract, you can share Heavenly Fate points. By then, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' death trap will collapse on its own—because your fates are no longer opposed, but synchronized."

"But the prerequisite is—" He looked at the Demonic Path commander. "You must return all the fate fragments you devoured."

The air seemed to freeze.

The Demonic Path commander's expression shifted between dark and light, his black eyes filled with struggle and hatred. Returning the fate fragments meant losing all the power he had devoured over ten thousand years, reduced to a "waste material" like Chen Ji.

For him, this was harder to accept than death.

"Why should I trust you?" He gritted his teeth. "Your remnant soul has plotted for ten thousand years—who knows how many hidden cards you still haven't revealed!"

Mo Xiansheng shook his head. "Believe it or not is your choice. But you should know—with your current state, you are no match for Chen Ji."

He pointed at Chen Ji. "The Tianji Record, though incomplete, records the fundamental laws of Heavenly Secrets. Each fragment you devour deepens your connection to Heavenly Secrets, yet pushes you further from true power."

"And him—" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried admiration. "Relying only on a single fragment page, he walked to today step by step, never taking any shortcuts. This temperament is why the Tianji Record truly chose him."

The Demonic Path commander's face sank completely.

He knew he had lost. Not in power, but in vision. Ten thousand years of布局, ultimately couldn't overcome a single "steady" character.

Chen Ji stepped forward, extending his hand. "Alright. I accept."

The Demonic Path commander was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter, though the laughter carried bitterness. He extended his hand, their palms meeting.

In an instant, two beams of light surged from their palms, intertwining, entangling, and resonating in the void—that was the voice of fate, recounting a bond forcibly torn apart for ten thousand years, finally beginning to heal.

text.content:
"Shared Fate is possible." Chen Ji's voice carried no emotion. "But you need to return what's mine first."

The Demonic Path commander narrowed his eyes, a dangerous glint flashing within. "You don't trust me?"

"Mutual." Chen Ji replied calmly. "You want sincerity, I give it. But sincerity is reciprocal—you return first, I sign the contract afterward. This isn't about trust, it's about principle."

Their gazes collided in the void, sparks flying.

text.content:
"No need." Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression cold and detached. "I'll obtain your Life Fate Fragment myself. I don't need your charity."

The Demonic Path Commander's face instantly darkened like water. The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng let out a soft sigh but said nothing more.

"Fine... fine!" The Demonic Path Commander laughed in fury, demonic flames around him surging once more. "Since you don't appreciate kindness, don't blame me for not caring about our shared roots!"

Chen Ling stood in front of Chen Ji, but Chen Ji gently pulled her behind him, his gaze calmly meeting the Demonic Path Commander's eyes.

"Want to make a move?" he murmured. "I'm ready to face you until the end."

dialogue.content:
At this critical moment, Ling Yuan suddenly spoke: "Enough."

His voice was not loud, yet it exploded like thunder in everyone's ears. The Demonic Path Commander's demonic flames faltered slightly, as if fearing something.

"I've said so much, not to watch you tear each other apart." Ling Yuan slowly walked between the two, his aged gaze sweeping over Chen Ji before falling on the Demonic Path Commander. "Since Senior Brother Mo's remnant soul has appeared, there are things that should be clarified once and for all."

He raised his hand, and the Fate Formation Diagram emerged once more. "The deadly trap set by the Heavenly Eye is not centered on either of you—it lies with the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'"

Chen Ling's body trembled.

"She is the only link connecting the Twin Destinies." Ling Yuan gazed at Chen Ling, a complex light flickering in his eyes. "When Senior Brother rescued her from the Holy Sect back then, it was precisely for today."

"Chen Ling..." Chen Ji turned to look at his sister.

Chen Ling bit her lower lip tightly and murmured: "Brother, I know what you want to ask. But I... I still can't tell you now."

text.content:
The atmosphere suddenly became extremely delicate.

Chen Ji stared at Chen Ling's pale face, a complex emotion surging in his heart. This sister who had been missing for years, suddenly appearing and standing before him, now saying such words—how many secrets was she still hiding?

"Chen Ling." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable firmness. "Whatever mission you have, you shouldn't hide it from me. I'm your brother."

Chen Ling's eyes slightly reddened.

She opened her mouth, seemingly wanting to say something, when suddenly, a desolate scream came from the distance.

"Ah—!"

Everyone turned to look. The transfer array at the ruins entrance lit up once more, and a disheveled figure tumbled out from it.

It was Ye Qing.

The Demonic Path Saint Woman's clothes were torn, covered in blood, her face as pale as a ghost. She stumbled toward them, black mist churning behind her, as if something was in pursuit.

"Help... help me..." she shrieked, her voice filled with terror.

The Demonic Path Commander's pupils constricted. "Those are the pursuers I deployed—"

Black mist surged forth like a tide, and a figure emerged from within.

It was a faceless person.

No, that's not right—its face kept shifting, sometimes an old face, sometimes a young one, sometimes a man, sometimes a woman. The only constant was the blood-red flame burning in those empty eye sockets.

"Heavenly Path Puppet!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul cried out in alarm. "How could it appear here!"

The Heavenly Path Puppet—that was a tool the Heavenly Eye used to eliminate variables. Whenever someone attempted to break its arrangement, it would dispatch such puppets to return everything to its proper course.

And now, its appearance here clearly meant—

"It's because of us." Chen Ji murmured. "The simultaneous appearance of the Twin Destinies triggered its warning mechanism."

The Demonic Path Commander's expression turned extremely unsightly. He clearly hadn't expected this.

"Chen Ji!" he shouted. "Let's join forces to deal with this thing first!"

Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply stood there, gazing quietly at the Heavenly Path Puppet.

In his mind, the Tianji Record suddenly shook violently—a blurred image emerged, yet because of Chen Ling's presence, it became fragmented.

But even so, he still caught a few key words:

Betrayal, conspiracy, destiny...

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head.

He remembered what Ling Yuan had just said—the Heavenly Eye split destiny to prevent prophets from glimpsing its true form. And the reason the Heavenly Fate Lock Key could disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight was because her existence would "blur" any prophetic image related to her.

But what if...

What if someone deliberately used this "blur" to hide something?

Chen Ji turned to look at Ye Qing.

The Demonic Path Saint Woman was slumped on the ground, gasping, appearing completely disheveled. But Chen Ji noticed—at a certain moment, her eyes had exchanged a brief glance with Ling Yuan.

That was not a look of seeking help.

That was a look of confirmation.

"Interesting." Chen Ji murmured, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

He recalled the content from the next chapter hook—Ye Qing's betrayal was also part of the Twin Destinies plan.

So that's how it was.

The Demonic Path Commander might not know, but Chen Ji had already seen the next move in the chess game.

Blade light and sword shadow, killing intent pervasive.

The Heavenly Path Puppet let out a piercing shriek and lunged toward the crowd. The Demonic Path Commander struck first, demonic flames transforming into ten thousand ghosts wailing in agony, clashing with the puppet.

Chen Ji did not move.

He stood in place, his gaze shifting away from the fierce battle between the Demonic Path Commander and the Heavenly Path Puppet, falling instead on Ling Yuan.

The old Sect Master wore a faint smile as he watched everything unfold, as if all was within his calculations.

"Senior." Chen Ji suddenly spoke.

Ling Yuan raised an eyebrow. "Hmm?"

"Ye Qing's betrayal—was arranged by you, wasn't it." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it exploded like thunder beside Ling Yuan's ear.

Ling Yuan's smile froze slightly.

"You think I don't know?" Chen Ji continued. "When Ye Qing 'betrayed' the Demonic Path to join the Tianqing Sect, I found it suspicious. How could a Demonic Path Saint Woman so easily defect? Unless—she was a piece placed here from the beginning."

He stepped forward, his gaze sharp as a blade. "And her true master is not the Demonic Path Commander—it's you, Ling Yuan."

"Ling Yuan's silence was the best answer.

"I have been laying plans for ten thousand years to break the dead end of the Heavenly Eye." His voice remained calm, "But Chen Ji, you should understand—in a chess game, every piece has its purpose."

"So you used Ye Qing, used the Demonic Path commander, used everyone." Chen Ji sneered, "Including me?"

"Including you." Ling Yuan admitted without hesitation, "But there's one thing you're wrong about—I never intended to harm you. You are the successor chosen by your senior brother, the only one who might break this dead end. Everything I've done was to pave the way for you."

"Pave the way?" Chen Ji's gaze turned icy cold, "What about Chen Ling? Was her being taken by the Holy Sect also part of your arrangement?"

Ling Yuan's expression finally flickered.

"That was an accident." he said, his voice losing some of its composure, "I didn't expect the Holy Sect to target the Heavenly Fate Lock. If not for that, I would have—"

"Would have what?" A cold voice interrupted him.

Chen Ling had somehow walked up to Ling Yuan, her pale face carrying a coldness never seen before: "Senior Ling Yuan, I ask you—back when you 'rescued' me from the Holy Sect, did you already know the true purpose of the Heavenly Fate Lock?"

"Ling Yuan did not answer.
